mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will negatively impact corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving S&P 500 returns lower over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a deteriorating labor market that will weigh on consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating expansion in industrial production signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate revenues and earnings, driving S&P 500 returns higher over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following an accelerating INDPRO expansion

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in inflation as measured by CPI will prompt the Fed to raise interest rates, which increases the discount rate on future cash flows and negatively impacts equity valuations, leading to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a CPI spike

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline significantly and the unemployment rate is already elevated, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will negatively impact economic growth and equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 5% in 3 months and UNRATE > 6%
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth is strong and the unemployment rate is low, it signals a tight labor market that will support consumer spending and boost corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k over 3 months and UNRATE < 4%
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 45% of triggered instances

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising and inflation is already high, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and negatively impact equity valuations, leading to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 3%
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth accelerating signals a strengthening economy that will boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
